card.name: Words leading into subscribe or newsletter offers
card.fires_on: Words in website sign-up prompts where the next word is likely subscription or subscribe, such as annual, FREE after inbox, sign up, and RSS how-to lines.

modes.label: Free inbox offer
modes.description: The word FREE or the following mark ending a line about getting health news delivered to your inbox.
modes.example: Get the latest health and medical information delivered direct to your inbox<< FREE>>!

modes.label: Plan wording
modes.description: A word describing a subscription plan or discount, right before the word subscription.
modes.example: you'll also receive 30% off your<< annual>> subscription.

modes.label: Sign-up prompts
modes.description: Words in newsletter, mailing list or RSS invitations.
modes.example: Click here to<< sign>> up for our newsletter

card.writes: It pushes the model to write subscription, subscribe and similar words next.
card.plain: It lights up on website wording that invites you to subscribe or sign up for emails.
